hooks.command: s=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); c=$(printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -E 'amplify/|global-perspectives-starter/frontend/src/' | grep -vE 'package-lock|node_modules'); d=$(printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -E 'project-docs/|CHANGES\.md'); if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -z "$d" ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"📝 Docs reminder: code changed but no project-docs/ or CHANGES.md update is in the working tree — update the docs it references in the SAME commit (see project-docs/playbooks/TASK_WORKFLOW.md)."}'; fi; exit 0
